purpose: Dataset access and source-schema evidence. SUPPORT2 remains header-only; Nepal outcome preparation and model evaluation are documented separately in the Nepal evidence artifacts.

support2.target: hospdead; do not substitute long-term death
support2.timing: Most assessments are study day three, not first ICU day.
support2.use: Additional separately defined benchmark; not eligible as a frozen first-day WiDS external test.
support2.permission: Publisher grants anyone dataset use with original citation and Vanderbilt acknowledgement. This does not assert a CC redistribution license.

nepal_registry.browser_download: Normal Download file click timed out after 15000ms; browser reported no completed downloads.
nepal_registry.eligibility: Prepared recorded-adult ICU-mortality sensitivity; not hospital-mortality validation. First-versus-extrema windows, unsupported/mixed-unit inputs, absent hospital IDs and canonical person linkage prevent original external eligibility.
nepal_registry.acquisition: Owner supplied the official workbook locally after earlier failed tool downloads.
nepal_registry.native_text_only_source_dictionary: Generic CCAA core dictionary linked by the Nepal methods article, not a verified export-specific unit flag.

mendeley_candidates.limitation: AFICILL reports a death-or-ICU-transfer composite in a step-down unit. Dresden is a selected cardiogenic-shock cohort. Neither is a verified first-day WiDS substitute.
